applicabilityBasis.summary: USDY is a tokenized note offered under Regulation S to qualifying non-U.S. investors, with yield reflected in an increasing redemption price. The issuer describes current issuance under Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited's Ondo Stocks umbrella, while separate daily reports continue to reconcile outstanding legacy Ondo USDY LLC obligations. The excluded-security classification concerns the note structure, not an assertion that all outstanding issuance is a single BVI liability.

references.label: Ondo Global Markets legal and regulatory

genius.notes: USDY is structured as a tokenized secured note under Reg S, accessible to qualifying non-U.S. investors, and accrues yield through NAV appreciation. On 2026-10-07, issuer docs still describe the December 15, 2025 move into the Ondo Stocks umbrella and direct USDC redemption through Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited, but preserve bank-wire redemption through Ondo USDY LLC. The LLC's 2026-09-25 attestation expressly excludes BVI issuance. Current BVI issuance and outstanding legacy LLC obligations therefore have distinct reporting scope. Existing excluded-security/not-applicable classifications are retained; this review does not assert a new regulatory authorization.
